messages:
morgan: :rotating_light: alert — spike in 5xx + timeouts on inference-gateway since ~12:10 UTC. Grafana shows p95 jumped from ~250ms -> 2s, p99 ~4.5s; 504s and 502s climbing. Error rate ~8% for the last 5m. I think this started right after the canary completed at 12:05.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-04-12-ig-timeout-regression; paging morgan, sam, rachel. Severity: sev2.

deploy-bot: Completed deploy: inference-gateway v2026.4.12-54 @ 12:04:52 UTC (canary 10% -> 100%).

sam: seeing same — curl -> 504s hitting the gateway frontends. Fast repro: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` returns `504` within 3s. Traces show long wait in `router.forward` to `runtime-proxy`.

zoe: jumping in — tagging metrics: `infra/inference-gateway/errors{code=5xx}` link: https://grafana/redwood/d/ig-errors (shared). Doing a quick `kubectl logs` on gateway-frontend.

morgan: can we set circuit breaker to failfast to reduce tail? Current policy is 60s. If we can flip to 2s that will at least stop long queues and reduce p99.

sam: agreed. On it. `kubectl patch deploy inference-gateway --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"circuit-breaker-ms":"2000"}}}}}'`

deploy-bot: Patch applied to inference-gateway deployment (annotation set: circuit-breaker-ms=2000).

rachel: note — a lot of clients use multiplexing; even short queuing in frontends is amplifying into backend stalls. Also seeing `kvcache` thrash in runtime-metrics. Might be kvcache eviction/serialization contended after the new batching tweak.

morgan: lemme check canary diff — v2026.4.12-54 changed batch-heuristic: default max-concurrent-batches increased, and changed `kv_prefetch` to true. Could explain more memory/lock contention.

sam: we should rollback the deploy. Traffic still hitting new version and errors are customer impacting (chat features degrade). Rolling back now to v2026.4.12-53.

sam: `/deploy rollback inference-gateway v2026.4.12-53 --reason "timeout regression p99 spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started: inference-gateway -> v2026.4.12-53. Initiated by sam @ 12:17:03 UTC.

incident-bot: Noted. Add timeline entry: rollback initiated at 12:17 UTC.

zoe: watch logs for `kvcache` errors. If rollback finishes can we also drain connections on new pods?

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: inference-gateway now running v2026.4.12-53 across 100% of traffic @ 12:19:41 UTC.

morgan: initial checks: sending synthetic at 12:20:05 UTC - 200/OK, p95 ~ 270ms. Error rate down to baseline (~0.4%).

rachel: verified traces — no more long `router.forward` waits, kvcache miss rate normalized. Looks like the batch heuristic change was the likely trigger.

sam: customer impact: degraded for ~13 minutes (12:06 -> 12:19), spike in 5xx/timeouts for ~10–12m. Affected clients: web chat and some mobile conversational flows. Estimated requests affected ~18k, error budget hit ~0.03%.

morgan: creating follow-up: ENG-RUNBOOK ticket to revert the batching change in next canary and add a staged ramp. Also add automated smoke-tests that hit multiplexing hotpaths.

rachel: also add telemetry alert: if p99 > 2s AND 5xx rate > 2% for 3m, auto-route 20% traffic to stable variant and pause canary.

zoe: handing off to 2nd oncall for postmortem and customer follow-ups. @oncall-handoff-bot take over.

oncall-handoff-bot: Handoff acknowledged. Next oncall: zoe (overnight). Summary: rollback done, services healthy, root-cause suspected batching + kvcache interaction. Follow-ups assigned to morgan/sam/rachel.

sam: adding short log excerpt for notes:
```
[12:10:12] router.forward wait=4231ms -> upstream=runtime-proxy/10.2.5.12: grpc deadline exceeded
[12:11:02] runtime-proxy: kvcache eviction spike: evicted=12493, latency-ms=87
[12:12:43] gateway: 502 Bad Gateway from runtime-proxy (error: upstream timeout)
```

morgan: quick checklist for post-incident: 1) pin safe batching defaults, 2) add per-model kv_prefetch gating, 3) add canary traffic ramp guard (error spikes pause), 4) evaluation harness for multiplex load.

rachel: filing the incident report now (INC-2026-04-12-ig-timeout-regression). Will include timeline, graphs, and suggested roll-forward plan.

zoe: thanks all — I'll monitor for the next hour and escalate if anything reappears. :white_check_mark:

morgan: closing live mitigation: rollback successful, customer impact contained, handoff complete. Follow-up owners: morgan (batching change revert), rachel (postmortem), sam (deployment guard).

oncall-handoff-bot: Thread transferred to incidents-oncall channel for postmortem drafting.
